27/05/2026, 6:13 pm - Vignesh: #include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

typedef struct
{
    char name[100];
    char language[50];
    int year;
    float rating;
} Movie;

/* Function Prototypes */

int countMovies(char filename[]);
Movie* allocateMemory(int count);
void readMovies(char filename[], Movie *movies, int count);
void displayMoviesFromFile(char filename[], int n);
void sortMovies(Movie *movies, int count);
void writeMovies(char filename[], Movie *movies, int count);
void freeMemory(Movie **movies);

/* Main Function */
int main()
{
    char inputFile[] = "IMDb_400_Movies1.csv";
    char outputFile[] = "sorted_movies.csv";
    int count, n;
    count = countMovies(inputFile);
    Movie *movies = allocateMemory(count);
    readMovies(inputFile, movies, count);
    printf("Enter how many movie records to display: ");
    scanf("%d", &n);
    if(n > count)
    {
        n = count;
    }
    printf("\nBefore Sorting:\n\n");
    displayMoviesFromFile(inputFile, n);
    sortMovies(movies, count);
    writeMovies(outputFile, movies, count);
    printf("\nAfter Sorting:\n\n");
    displayMoviesFromFile(outputFile, n);
    printf("\nSorted movie data stored successfully.\n");
    freeMemory(&movies);
    return 0;
}

/* Function Definitions */
int countMovies(char filename[])
{
    FILE *fp;
    char line[300];
    int count = 0;
    fp = fopen(filename, "r");
    if(fp == NULL)
    {
        printf("File cannot be opened\n");
        return 0;
    }
    fgets(line, sizeof(line), fp);
    while(fgets(line, sizeof(line), fp))
    {
        count++;
    }
    fclose(fp);
    return count;
}

Movie* allocateMemory(int count)
{
    Movie *movies;
    movies = (Movie*)malloc(count * sizeof(Movie));
    if(movies == NULL)
    {
        printf("Memory allocation failed\n");
        exit(1);
    }
    return movies;
}

void readMovies(char filename[], Movie *movies, int count)
{
    FILE *fp;
    char line[300];
    int i = 0;
    fp = fopen(filename, "r");
    if(fp == NULL)
    {
        printf("File cannot be opened\n");
        return;
    }
    fgets(line, sizeof(line), fp);
    while(fgets(line, sizeof(line), fp) && i < count)
    {
        sscanf(line, "%99[^,],%49[^,],%d,%f",
               movies[i].name,
               movies[i].language,
               &movies[i].year,
               &movies[i].rating);
        i++;
    }
    fclose(fp);
}

void displayMoviesFromFile(char filename[], int n)
{
    FILE *fp;
    char line[300];
    int count = 0;
    fp = fopen(filename, "r");
    if(fp == NULL)
    {
        printf("File cannot be opened\n");
        return;
    }
    fgets(line, sizeof(line), fp);
    while(fgets(line, sizeof(line), fp) && count < n)
    {
        char name[100], language[50];
        int year;
        float rating;
        sscanf(line, "%99[^,],%49[^,],%d,%f",
               name,
               language,
               &year,
               &rating);
        printf("%s | %s | %d | %.1f\n",
               name,
               language,
               year,
               rating);
        count++;
    }
    fclose(fp);
}

void sortMovies(Movie *movies, int count)
{
    int i, j;
    Movie temp;
    for(i = 0; i < count - 1; i++)
    {
        for(j = 0; j < count - i - 1; j++)
        {
            if(strcmp(movies[j].name, movies[j + 1].name) > 0)
            {
                temp = movies[j];
                movies[j] = movies[j + 1];
                movies[j + 1] = temp;
            }
        }
    }
}

void writeMovies(char filename[], Movie *movies, int count)
{
    FILE *fp;
    int i;
    fp = fopen(filename, "w");
    if(fp == NULL)
    {
        printf("Cannot create output file\n");
        return;
    }
    fprintf(fp, "Movie Name,Language,Year,Rating\n");
    for(i = 0; i < count; i++)
    {
        fprintf(fp, "%s,%s,%d,%.1f\n",
                movies[i].name,
                movies[i].language,
                movies[i].year,
                movies[i].rating);
    }
    fclose(fp);
}

void freeMemory(Movie **movies)
{
    free(*movies);
    *movies = NULL;
}

05/06/2026, 6:46 pm - Ramya Clg: #include <SDL2/SDL.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdio.h>

// Engine Constants
#define SCREEN_WIDTH 800
#define SCREEN_HEIGHT 600
#define FPS 60
#define FRAME_TARGET_TIME (1000 / FPS)

// Engine State Structure
typedef struct {
    SDL_Window* window;
    SDL_Renderer* renderer;
    bool is_running;
    int last_frame_time;
    
    // Simple game object data
    float player_x;
    float player_y;
    float player_width;
    float player_height;
} Engine;

// Initialize window, renderer, and state
bool engine_initialize(Engine* engine) {
    if (SDL_Init(SDL_INIT_VIDEO) != 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error initializing SDL: %s\n", SDL_GetError());
        return false;
    }

    engine->window = SDL_CreateWindow(
        "Basic 2D Graphic Engine",
        SDL_WINDOWPOS_CENTERED,
        SDL_WINDOWPOS_CENTERED,
        SCREEN_WIDTH,
        SCREEN_HEIGHT,
        SDL_WINDOW_SHOWN
    );

    if (!engine->window) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error creating SDL Window: %s\n", SDL_GetError());
        return false;
    }

    // Create hardware-accelerated renderer
    engine->renderer = SDL_CreateRenderer(engine->window, -1, SDL_RENDERER_ACCELERATED);
    if (!engine->renderer) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error creating SDL Renderer: %s\n", SDL_GetError());
        return false;
    }

    // Set initial object values
    engine->player_x = 100.0f;
    engine->player_y = 100.0f;
    engine->player_width = 50.0f;
    engine->player_height = 50.0f;
    
    engine->last_frame_time = SDL_GetTicks();
    engine->is_running = true;
    return true;
}

// Handle OS events and user input
void engine_process_input(Engine* engine) {
    SDL_Event event;
    while (SDL_PollEvent(&event)) {
        switch (event.type) {
            case SDL_QUIT:
                engine->is_running = false;
                break;
            case SDL_KEYDOWN:
                if (event.key.keysym.sym == SDLK_ESCAPE) {
                    engine->is_running = false;
                }
                break;
        }
    }

    // Continuous keyboard state scanning for movement
    const Uint8* keystates = SDL_GetKeyboardState(NULL);
    if (keystates[SDL_SCANCODE_LEFT])  engine->player_x -= 5.0f;
    if (keystates[SDL_SCANCODE_RIGHT]) engine->player_x += 5.0f;
    if (keystates[SDL_SCANCODE_UP])    engine->player_y -= 5.0f;
    if (keystates[SDL_SCANCODE_DOWN])  engine->player_y += 5.0f;
}

// Update physics, positions, and engine variables
void engine_update(Engine* engine) {
    // Lock the engine loop to the target frame rate (60 FPS capping)
    int time_to_wait = FRAME_TARGET_TIME - (SDL_GetTicks() - engine->last_frame_time);
    if (time_to_wait > 0 && time_to_wait <= FRAME_TARGET_TIME) {
        SDL_Delay(time_to_wait);
    }
    engine->last_frame_time = SDL_GetTicks();

    // Bound check limits to keep rectangle inside the window boundaries
    if (engine->player_x < 0) engine->player_x = 0;
    if (engine->player_y < 0) engine->player_y = 0;
    if (engine->player_x + engine->player_width > SCREEN_WIDTH) {
        engine->player_x = SCREEN_WIDTH - engine->player_width;
    }
    if (engine->player_y + engine->player_height > SCREEN_HEIGHT) {
        engine->player_y = SCREEN_HEIGHT - engine->player_height;
    }
}

// Execute the rendering pass onto the back buffer
void engine_render(Engine* engine) {
    // 1. Clear the screen (Fill with dark blue background)
    SDL_SetRenderDrawColor(engine->renderer, 20, 20, 40, 255);
    SDL_RenderClear(engine->renderer);

    // 2. Draw our test 2D Primitive Shape (Green Rectangle)
    SDL_Rect player_rect = {
        (int)engine->player_x,
        (int)engine->player_y,
        (int)engine->player_width,
        (int)engine->player_height
    };
    SDL_SetRenderDrawColor(engine->renderer, 0, 255, 100, 255);
    SDL_RenderFillRect(engine->renderer, &player_rect);

    // 3. Swap video buffers to present the frame onto the monitor
    SDL_RenderPresent(engine->renderer);
}

// Safely terminate and clean allocations
void engine_shutdown(Engine* engine) {
    SDL_DestroyRenderer(engine->renderer);
    SDL_DestroyWindow(engine->window);
    SDL_Quit();
}

// Application entry point
int main(int argc, char* argv[]) {
    Engine engine = {0};

    if (!engine_initialize(&engine)) {
        printf("Engine initialization failed.\n");
        return -1;
    }

    // Core Engine Loop
    while (engine.is_running) {
        engine_process_input(&engine);
        engine_update(&engine);
        engine_render(&engine);
    }

    engine_shutdown(&engine);
    return 0;
}

#define WIDTH 800

int main() {

    SDL_Init(SDL_INIT_VIDEO);

    SDL_Window *window = SDL_CreateWindow(
        "2D Engine",
        SDL_WINDOWPOS_CENTERED,
        SDL_WINDOWPOS_CENTERED,
        WIDTH,
        HEIGHT,
        0
    );

    SDL_Renderer *renderer = SDL_CreateRenderer(
        window,
        -1,
        SDL_RENDERER_ACCELERATED
    );

    bool running = true;
    SDL_Event event;

    int x = 100;
    int y = 100;

    while(running) {

        while(SDL_PollEvent(&event)) {

            if(event.type == SDL_QUIT)
                running = false;

            if(event.type == SDL_KEYDOWN) {

                switch(event.key.keysym.sym) {

                    case SDLK_LEFT:
                        x -= 10;

                    case SDLK_RIGHT:
                        x += 10;
                        break;

                    case SDLK_UP:
                        y -= 10;
                        break;

                    case SDLK_DOWN:
                        y += 10;
                        break;
                }
            }
        }

        SDL_RenderFillRect(renderer, &player);

        SDL_RenderPresent(renderer);
    }

    SDL_DestroyRenderer(renderer);
    SDL_DestroyWindow(window);
    SDL_Quit();

    return 0;
}
